steps.label: 1. Incident Created
steps.sub: phishing analytics rule fires, Medium severity

steps.label: 2. Rule Evaluates
steps.sub: condition matches the phishing detection name

code:
TRIGGER: When incident is created
CONDITION: Analytics rule name = "Phishing Email Reported"
ACTION: Run Playbook "Notify-SOC-Teams"
caption: The condition is what keeps this rule from firing on unrelated incidents.

code:
ACTION 1: Get incident details
  -> reporting user, sender, extracted URLs

ACTION 2: Post to #soc-alerts in Teams
  -> incident link, sender address

ACTION 3: Add tag "auto-notified" to the incident
caption: Notify and tag — it gets a human looking faster, it doesn't act on its own judgment.

steps.label: Not Auto-Closed
steps.sub: an analyst still decides the outcome

steps.label: No Action on Sender
